content:
Vera (Ops): Quick heads-up — we’re rolling out a soft-open for H550 dedicated pools starting tomorrow. EU-Central (euc-1) and SFO (sfo-2) will be on rotational availability windows. Readout and reservation playbook below.
DeployBot: Scheduled maintenance window created: 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC — 2026-04-01 08:00 UTC. Allocation policy: rotational, fairshare-weight=1.2.
Vera (Ops): TL;DR: H550 is optimized for mixed-precision inference on medium-length contexts. Expect ~1.6x throughput vs our current h200 for most decoder-only models.
Maria P: Pricing impact? SLA changes?
Vera (Ops): Pricing: short-term trial pricing is set at $1.95/hr per GPU for reserved blocks during the soft-open, then will normalize to standard dedicated pricing after the roll. No SLA change for Dedicated pools during soft-open but latency SLOs will be monitored closely.
Capacity Planner: Rotation windows (local times):
 - EU-Central (euc-1): Mon/Wed/Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC (capacity wave A)
 - SFO (sfo-2): Tue/Thu/Sat 10:00-14:00 UTC (capacity wave B)
 - Burst floor: 8 GPUs per zone during non-rotation.
Infra Oncall: Important: preemptible fallbacks are disabled for H550 during the trial. If you have routing policies that assumed preemptible fallback, please update to explicit fallback models or regions.
Sanjay K: For customers on A100 reservations — migration plan?
Vera (Ops): Recommended path: 1) Start a canary on H550 with 10-20% traffic. 2) Use our routing policy to fallback to A100/A10g if latency > SLO or errors spike. 3) If your model uses FP16 kernels, test the quant profile below.
Vera (Ops): Example reservation CLI for SE teams and early customers:
```
redwoodctl reservations create --pool h550-euc-1 --gpus 16 --term 720h --priority reserved --tags "h550-migration,canary"
```
Capacity Planner: Note on tagging: add a `h550-migration` tag to identify trial reservations for billing + opt-in telemetry. We'll automatically attach perf profiles for these reservations.
Maria P: Any special runtime flags we should send?
Vera (Ops): Yes — set `--quant-profile auto_mixed` and enable `kv-cache=on` for best perf. Also recommend `max_batch_size=32` for chat workloads. Example runtime config snippet:
```
{"model": "gpt-medium-1", "quant_profile": "auto_mixed", "kv_cache": true, "max_batch_size": 32}
```
Infra Oncall: Watchlist for oncall: network egress spikes and nvlink errors. If you see `nvlink-err` in logs, page infra-oncall immediately.
Sanjay K: Are rollback playbooks ready?
Vera (Ops): Yes — rollback is a single policy flip in Console to route traffic to fallback pool + cancel new reservations. Ops runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/h550-rollback (internal).
DeployBot: Reminder — quotas will be adjusted for trial participants. Expect a quota increase email if you created a reservation with `h550-migration` tag.
Vera (Ops): Action items: @capacity teams — create 2 reserved windows for customer trials in euc-1 by EOD today. @eng-runtime — validate quant kernels for the top 5 customer models. @support — prepare FAQ snippet about migration and pricing.
Capacity Planner: Will post the per-customer reservation calendar once we confirm DR plan.
Maria P: Thanks — will coordinate comms and update the public docs draft.
Vera (Ops): OK — please react with :thumbsup: when you’ve picked your owners. Keeping this thread for live updates during the soft-open.
